# Leadoro

> Done-for-you AI lead automation for service businesses — WhatsApp, forms, and social DMs captured, qualified, and booked into your calendar automatically, 24/7.

Leadoro builds and manages AI-powered lead pipelines for clinics, real estate agents, salons, coaches, and other service businesses. When a prospect messages on WhatsApp, fills a form, or sends a DM, Leadoro responds in under 30 seconds, qualifies them with conversational questions, nurtures cold leads with timed follow-up sequences, and books appointments directly into the owner's calendar — with no manual effort required.

The service is fully managed: clients complete one 15-minute onboarding call, then Leadoro handles setup, monitoring, and monthly reporting.

## Proof of Work (Selected Projects)

- **Alessio · Dream Gym Italy** — Bilingual IT/EN AI voice agent for a 150-location fitness chain. Auto-detects caller language, fuzzy-matches nearest gym, books appointments into Google Calendar 24/7. Stack: ElevenLabs, n8n, Google Calendar, Bilingual NLP.
- **Neo AI Running Coach** — AI WhatsApp running coach with automated Stripe subscription billing and GPT-4o personalised weekly training plans. Stack: n8n, GPT-4o, Stripe, Supabase, WhatsApp.
- **WhatsApp Recruitment Agent · Germany** — GDPR-compliant German-language recruitment bot. Gmail triggers Claude AI to extract applicant data, verify consent, run Q&A, and book interviews. Stack: n8n, Claude AI, 360Dialog, WhatsApp Business API, Gmail, Google Calendar.
- **StarPlay IPTV · Brazil** — 10-workflow WhatsApp sales funnel with 5 AI agents, isolated Postgres memory, GPT-4o Vision screenshot support, SPIN upsell agent, and scheduled remarketing. Stack: n8n, GPT-4o, PostgreSQL, WhatsApp API.
- **Bilingual Sales Agent · DB Studio (FR/EN)** — AI voice agent for inbound sales, detecting language instantly, qualifying across 3 pricing tiers, booking consultations, and sending SMS confirmations via Twilio. Stack: Retell AI, Twilio, Google Calendar.
- **AI Voice Receptionist · Solo Affitti Italy** — Bilingual IT/EN AI receptionist for a real estate rental agency answering property inquiries, qualifying tenants, and booking viewings after hours. Stack: ElevenLabs, n8n, Voice AI.
- **German Booking Agent · Friseursalon Istanbul** — German-language AI voice agent identifying callers and booking appointments directly into GoHighLevel for a hair salon. Stack: ElevenLabs, GoHighLevel, Voice AI.

## Key Facts

- Service type: Managed AI lead automation (done-for-you, no client involvement after onboarding)
- Channels supported: WhatsApp Business API, website contact forms, social media DMs
- Industries served: Clinics, real estate, salons, coaches, home services, and other local service businesses
- Response time: Under 30 seconds for every inbound lead, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
- Onboarding: One 15-minute call, then fully handled by Leadoro
- Reporting: Monthly video report from a dedicated specialist
